actionConfiguration.body: SELECT COALESCE(insurance_company, 'לא שויכה') AS "חברת_ביטוח", COUNT(*) AS "סגירות", COALESCE(SUM(closing_amount), 0) AS "סכום_סגירה", COALESCE(SUM(agent_appointment_amount), 0) AS "סכום_מינוי" FROM leads WHERE user_updated_at BETWEEN '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date AND '{{moment(DatePicker_End.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date AND touched_by_adi = TRUE AND insurance_company IS NOT NULL AND insurance_company <> '' AND closing_amount > 0 GROUP BY insurance_company ORDER BY "סגירות" DESC
